board: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow
programme: B.Tech CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), NEP-2020, effective 2024-25
note: Four subjects (DBMS, AI, DAA, AIML) come from the syllabus PDF the owner supplied. DS, DSTL and COA are second and third year AKTU courses that are not in that PDF, so their unit outlines come from the AKTU published outline, and DL is a standard curriculum because the university lists it as an elective. Every topic is a topic, not a summary: the model teaches it, the resource ladder is where the reading is.
